column1: # One row per claw verb. Tab-separated, 8 columns, '#' comments, '-' = empty.
#   id       palette/completion key; unique among actions
#   aliases  '|'-separated extra names (the bin/claw case-arm aliases)
#   glyph    one Nerd Font glyph, unique across the whole registry ('-' = none)
#   label    title case, shown in the palette
#   desc     <=40 chars, lower case, never names a sibling verb
#   run      snippet eval'd in the current zsh by _claw_action
#   flags    ',' separated: '-' none | '!' confirm | 'x' external (no shell
#            (help + completion only, never in the palette)
# Every remaining bin/claw dispatch arm carries a 'hidden' row below so the
# registry's coverage of the dispatcher is total (audit F-15).
